title: LT Power Cable Price in Pakistan 2026 — 11kV XLPE, 415V Armoured Cable, Complete Buyer Guide

summary_html: LT power cable price in Pakistan 2026: 4-core 16mm² aluminium armoured PKR 850–1,100/metre, 4-core 240mm² PKR 6,800–8,500/metre, 11kV XLPE 3-core 240mm² PKR 5,500–8,000/metre. Complete ampacity tables with Pakistani climate derating (45°C ground), DISCO burial specifications (LESCO/K-Electric), WAPDA-approved manufacturer list, aluminium vs copper comparison, import duty breakdown, and 8 Pakistan-first technical disclosures including soil thermal resistivity by region and landed cost methodology.
